newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crude prices firm, staying focused on Iraq.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crude prices firm, staying focused on Iraq.

text.p: Crude prices were firming up again late Tuesday after slipping from their peaks in the wake of the U.S. military strike against Iraq and the suspension of Iraq's oil-for-food deal with the United Nations.
Trading in the cash oil market was patchy, however, as the volatile price swings brought most business onto the futures exchange, market players said.

Nevertheless, domestic grade differentials and outright prices were showing sharp increases compared with their closing levels last Friday ahead of the three-day holiday weekend, led by October WTI, which gained about $1.10 a barrel to $23.30/40.
